name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for plastic surgeons?
description: AEO optimizes for AI-driven search and voice assistants, while traditional SEO focuses on standard search engine results pages.

mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for plastic surgeons?

acceptedAnswer.text: While traditional SEO focuses on ranking in standard search engine results pages through keywords and backlinks, AEO adapts to the evolving landscape of AI-driven search, voice assistants, and rich snippets. AEO emphasizes structured data, semantic understanding, and user intent to optimize for these newer forms of search. For plastic surgeons, this means optimizing content not just for text-based queries, but also for conversational questions and direct answers provided by AI, ensuring your practice is found where patients are searching now and in the future.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO optimizes for AI-driven search and voice assistants, while traditional SEO focuses on standard search engine results pages.
